# Pack: analysis-notes

CMS analysis notes, read from a local mirror of gitlab.cern.ch/tdr/notes - notes, sections, figures, bibliography and links to TWiki pages.

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Kind | `context` |
| Version | `0.1.0` |
| Needs a credential to publish | yes |
| Okg modules it needs | `document_starter`, `person`, `extraction` |
| Packs it needs | [`twiki`](../packs/twiki.md) |

## In which bundles

- Default in: [`cms-physics`](../bundles/cms-physics.md)
- Optional in: none

Add it to an instance with `archi add analysis-notes`.

## Sources

- `analysis-notes.analysis_notes`

## Questions

`archi init` asks these. Answer one with `--answer analysis_notes_<id>=VALUE`.

| Id | Type | Required | Default | Prompt |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `mirror_root` | `string` | yes |  | directory holding your analysis-note mirror (absolute path) |
| `min_notes` | `integer` | no | `1` | fewest note directories the mirror may hold |

## Credentials

The pack reads these environment variables. Only the names are listed. Set them in the environment of the shell that runs ingestion (okg and the downloaders): archi does not pass values from the instance's `.env` to ingestion.

- `CERN_GITLAB_TOKEN`

## Freshness limits

`archi doctor` compares each source's age with its limit.

| Source | Longest acceptable age |
|---|---|
| `analysis-notes.analysis_notes` | `7d` |

## Invariants

The pack owns these checks. They leave with it.

| Name | Severity | What it checks |
|---|---|---|
| `analysis_notes_coverage` | error | The analysis-note source must have live notes with sections. Required live subtypes: analysis_note, section. A missing one means the mirror was empty, the walker stopped matching its directories, or the connector regressed. |
